title: Honeysuckle | Charming 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Discover Honeysuckle, a designer WaterColor townhome footsteps to the beach and walkable to Seaside.
description_expanded: Honeysuckle Features - 1 Minute Walk to WaterColor Beach Club. - Next to WaterColor shopping and dining, including Gulf view dining at FOOW or upscale shopping at The WaterColor Store - 2-minute walk to Scratch Kitchen and Wine World - Parking for 1 car in the community lot. Parking is first come, first serve and a parking pass will be provided at check-in - Covered and furnished balcony. You can hear the waves! - Complimentary use of 2 Tommy Bahama backpack chairs and a Tommy Bahama Beach Umbrella - Explore WaterColor and 30A with the provided Taxi bikes. Two bikes are included with your stay and additional rentals are available. - Full kitchen on the 2nd floor with Bosch and Keurig appliances - Dining table with seating for 6 - Highchair available - 2nd Floor Living room with TV and DVD player - 2nd Floor Powder Room - Cable and WIFI throughout home - 1st Floor Laundry area with washer and dryer - Main entrance is on the E30A side of the building. A secondary entrance into the king suite is available next to the back parking lot. - Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and Community pools included with your reservation for up to 4 guests, age 5 and up - Community pools heated during cooler months and towel service available at the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Low Speed Vehicle (Golf cart) rentals are restricted at this location as access to charging outlets cannot be guaranteed - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee This beachside town home is your perfect getaway! Located in the Southside 30A Beach District of Watercolor, this two-bedroom townhome is the perfect home away from home. Walk to the Beach Club and Gulf in 60 seconds. Wonderful for families looking for a retreat in Watercolor! This home boasts two suites, 1 king and 2 twin beds. Enjoy an early morning cup of coffee or nightcap on the upper walk-out balcony where you can hear the gently rolling waves of the Gulf. Boasting all designer interiors, the living area is located on the upper level and features ample plush seating for everyone. The first-floor suites boast our high-end bedding and renovated baths. This light-filled home will delight you with all it has to offer!
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite | Private entrance, sitting area with two swivel captain’s chairs, TV and DVD player, dresser and walk-in closest storage, ensuite bath with renovated dual vanity sink, walk-in shower with bench seating and jetted tub
1st Floor Guest Suite | Sleeps 2 in twin beds, TV, dresser and closet storage, ensuite bath with vanity sink and combination shower/tub

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
